children: The Doha-listed Ahlibank, rated A by Fitch and A2 by Moody’s (both stable), is marketing a five-year fixed rate US dollar Regulation S issuance that will come under its updated $2 billion medium-term bond programme.
Barclays Bank PLC, QNB Capital, Deutsche Bank AG, Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, Mizuho international, and Standard Chartered have been appointed as joint lead managers.
The notes will be issued by ABQ Finance SPC, a special purpose company wholly owned by the lender, with Ahlibank listed as the guarantor.
(Writing by Bindu Rai, editing by Brinda Darasha)

title: Qatar’s Ahlibank to issue five-year USD Reg S bonds
